rationale: The workflow already implements the workflow_yaml optimizations supported by evidence for this job shape. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching) is already present via the actions/cache step keyed on package-lock.json with npm restore keys. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (custom job timeout) is already present with timeout-minutes: 10; the measured experiment (batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) added a timeout to a job that had none, which does not match this workflow. No other pattern applies: there is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE, P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST), no schedule (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), no test step (P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-SELECT), no Bazel (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), and CI history shows mostly failures with no representative successful-duration history to justify tightening the timeout (P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT) or adding path filters without risking coverage of lint, Prisma generation, and build checks (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER).
